messages:
alex: Heads-up — tenant ops flagged a case where customers can effectively bypass soft quota protections by routing traffic to a cheaper model variant. Can we add a guardrail in Console + API to surface net unit-econ impact? cc @maria @jamal

maria: Repro steps?

alex: Quick repro: 1) tenant creates route 'chat-main' pinned to 'gptx-standard' 2) client uses route-override header to switch to 'gptx-lite' during bursts 3) observed billing shows lower per-token price but cache/KV affinity drops and overall bill increases. Example tenant: tenant-id=riot-inc (screenshot in drive).

jamal: Is this a routing bug or a billing attribution mismatch?

alex: Little of both. Routing allows override + fallbacks but billing/console shows only raw token unit price. No preview of cache miss penalty or amortized latency cost.

tess: UX perspective — users equate 'cheaper model' with savings. We need a preview that simulates effective unit cost (token price + cache-affinity delta + latency SLO risk) before they flip routes.

maria: Proposal: add a dry-run API: PATCH /routes/:id?dry_run=true that returns {cost_delta, cache_hit_delta, warnings}. Console will show a lightweight 'What if' card that estimates bill change at different traffic percentages.

alex: Sketch: small panel in routing modal with a slider 'percent traffic to new model' + toggles for 'preserve session stickiness'. Backend reuses cost-sim service (same engine used by billing-preview).

jamal: Telemetry: emit route.preview event with sample of sessions evaluated and the simulated cost breakdown. That avoids heavy recompute and gives us signal for future guardrail tuning.

tess: Can we compute cache-affinity penalty heuristically? Idea: use recent per-model KV-hit-rate and session-stickiness metric to estimate miss-rate increase when switching models. Example: if session-stickiness<0.6 and model change -> penalty = 1 - kv_hit_rate * stickiness_factor.

maria: Data needed: per-model kv_hit_rate, avg_seq_len, recent tail latency. We'll query telemetry index 'cache_metrics.v1' and 'session_metrics.v1' for the last 7d sample. Should be cheap to aggregate for dry-run.

alex: UX copy: include an inline 'Why this might increase cost' expandable section that spells out 'lower token price but >50% cache eviction leads to +X% net tokens served'. Keep copy short and actionable.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: route-preview-api v1 -> canary tomorrow 2025-06-01 09:00 UTC :rocket:

jamal: One more related ask: quotas. Right now when a soft quota is hit we apply rate limits, but tenants can dodge by switching to a different model or using a dedicated pool. Console should warn when a route change would skirt an active soft quota and offer a knob 'preserve quota across variants'.

tess: Add a default 'enforce quota across fallbacks' checkbox in the routing UI. Default to ON for enterprise plans.

maria: I'll draft the API schema for dry_run and the telemetry event names (route.preview, route.apply_attempt). Alex — can you mock the Console panel for PM review?

alex: On it. Will post a quick Figma link later. Also can someone add these items to the rollout checklist: UX mock, API contract, cost-sim unit tests, telemetry sampling, alerting for anomalous previews?

jamal: Added to #release-war-room checklist (item id: RR-783).

tess: :thumbsup:
